size_basis: L x W x H mm, set by flow_graph/param/house_scrubbers.py (X-PAR-03)

design.duty: flue, leach off-gas and nitric vents
design.material: PP-H shell and in-house cut PP rings; PP mesh demister
design.service: flue, leach off-gas and nitric vents, atmospheric (duty sections 4 and 6)

nozzles.service: scrubbed CO2 to the cold box
scrubbed flue nitrogen to the cold box
leach vent to the NOx scrubber

material: CPVC shell, sump, and packing support, per AQS-STD-002 rules M1 and M2. Packing is polymer. No metal wetted part. IA-LEACH-NOX and IA-CLOSE-1 arrive from LEACH_CSTR_1 at up to 85 °C (X-MAT-09). Inlet section and sump CPVC per M5; the packed section above the quench may stay PVC-U once the gas temperature there is calculated (held). Corrosion allowance does not apply to the polymer.

layout.frame: origin at the envelope corner; column axis at x 300, y 300, z up
layout.nozzle_spread: the schedule gives face and height only; ports pack in one row per face/height group at the envelope face, 8 mm clear at the bore; extension spools cross the air gap and the shell wall
layout.vent_drain: N10 flush at the top head (2000 datum predates the column); N9 drain boss lapping the skirt ring at the plinth
layout.internals: support grid, two beds + redistribution disc, distributor, demister - envelope solids at the recorded layout elevations
layout.hardware_idiom: connection hardware flush at the envelope faces; nothing protrudes, bbox within the node envelope
